newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends weaker after routine sessio.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends weaker after routine sessio.

text.p: White sugar futures managed to hold above intraday lows on Monday and closed in mid-range with little movement seen on the spreads.
Turnover was on the light side at 1,412 lots, dominated by trades in the two nearby positions. Earlier crosses on the August/October spread boosted volume.
At the close, August was $1.90 lower at $313.00 and October down $1.30 at $305.00. Other positions ended slightly lower.
Traders said attention in London over the next two days would be concentrated on the May expiry in New York.
